year.sort: from the earliest craze to the most recent
year.era: Drop each craze into the decade it took off.
year.shot: In what year did {label} become a craze?

rows.label: Flappy Bird
rows.description: 2013 mobile video game by Dong Nguyen
rows.hook: has a player flap a tiny winged hero between green pipes, and was pulled by its maker at its peak

rows.label: Tamagotchi
rows.hook: is an egg-shaped keychain gadget whose virtual pet kids had to feed and clean up after

rows.label: Pokémon Trading Card Game
rows.description: 1996 collectible card game based on Pokémon
rows.hook: lets players battle with decks of collectible cards, and kids traded shiny holographic ones at school

rows.label: Gangnam Style
rows.hook: is a K-pop video where a singer does an invisible horse-riding dance that spread across the world on YouTube

rows.label: disco
rows.description: genre of dance music and a subculture that emerged in the 1970s from the United States' urban nightlife scene
rows.hook: brought mirror balls, bell-bottoms and thumping four-on-the-floor beats to dance floors

rows.label: Pokémon Go
rows.description: augmented reality mobile game based on the Pokémon franchise
rows.hook: sent millions of people out walking with their phones to catch virtual creatures placed on real-world maps

rows.label: tulip mania
rows.hook: saw buyers pay absurd prices for flower bulbs before collapse, the classic speculative bubble

rows.label: Sea-Monkeys
rows.hook: promised tiny instant pets that hatch from a pouch of powder in water, advertised in comic books

rows.label: Candy Crush Saga
rows.hook: has players swap colored sweets to match three in a row, a huge mobile and Facebook hit

rows.label: Pumpkin Spice Latte
rows.hook: is a seasonal fall coffee drink from Starbucks, flavored with cinnamon, nutmeg and clove

rows.label: Cha Cha Slide
rows.hook: is a line dance song that calls out moves like "to the left" and "criss cross"

rows.label: Furby
rows.hook: is an owl-like talking robot toy that was a must-have holiday gift and spoke its own made-up language
